notes.title: Frogmageddon! | Sunset Dreamland Presents
notes.content:
Wishlist Frogmageddon here! [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3201190/Frogmageddon/]https://store.steampowered.com/app/3201190/Frogmageddon/[/url]

In collaboration between Frog Mage Udon and Sunset Dreamland, Frogmageddon releases this December on Steam! Our game Frogmageddon is a Vampire Survivors-inspired survival game where you go from one lone frog to a whole army of frogs, fighting against hordes of slithery snakes. Fight intense battles between hundreds of enemies and counter by growing your army to hundreds of weapon-wielding frogs!

Originally made for the GMTK game jam, we are adding new weapons, controller support, steam achievements, and more! And who knows, maybe i'll add some Sole Iron Tail nods as well ;)

notes.title: Boxes O' All Sizes Update!
notes.content:
Woah! A new update full of awesome presents! Before the Holidays! Where did this come from!?

[b]Enhanced Controller Support[/b]
Sole Iron Tail has been upgraded to use the ReWired controller library. What does that mean for you? Well, not only are controllers much more easily detected, SIT should now work with most DirectInput, Playstation, Switch, etc. controllers without the need to adjust things on Steam! Playstation/Switch icons coming soon!

[b]Boxes O' All Sizes![/b]
What's up with that update name? Well aside from presents of all shapes and sizes, Sole Iron Tail has finally received support for all aspect ratios! And this isn't just for 16:10 champs! Have some retro monitor thats in *GASP* 4:3?!?! BAM, SIT supports it! Have a cool ultrawide that you just wish more games supported? BAM, SIT supports that too!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/10e9cdf6cf53e38473ecd349ad9516559a68877d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/1385da3cee658b1fc1b72ccc81d5cccb0c528c30.png[/img]

[b]Linux Support![/b]
Welcome my penguin brothers and sisters! You can now slip and slide on linux!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/a94381b25f45c5f940876affb698d94d7ae8be79.png[/img]

[b]What are you hiding...[/b]
So there is a pattern with all these updates. Ultimately, Sole Iron Tail is now SUPER DUPER UPGRADED FOR DECK. For those getting one next year, you'll have a super fun time with Deck-Enhanced SIT!
 [img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/c187d077cab4d0ae88f053cdb73f7d55c454e7f3.jpg[/img]

[b]The little-big present![/b]
Sole Iron Tail is on 30% discount during the holiday sale! Even if you've already got the game, give it another look. The Iron Tail got a new hat!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/975f56f4197dd3e2c371dd2731f9dc40b782ed79.png[/img]



You've reached the end of this update! Happy Holidays!

notes.title: SIT Launch Thank You!
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Sole Iron Tail has had a very fun launch week! There has been some amazing responses and moments relating to the full game. I want to give a big thanks to everyone who's wishlsited, played, bought, or even just glanced at the game so far!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/a0d380b5c32959908f05de97d4c4ba61c3556c29.png[/img]

Aside from your purchase, you can support the game by leaving a review, joining the discord, and participating with the community.

But what's next for the Iron Tail? Well, soon there will be a little bug fix/user experience update. Here's what to expect:

[list]
[*]For controller users, auto-keyboard placement during name entry.
[*]"Reset Save" button for those who just want to start fresh again!
[*]Minor menu fixes.
[*]"Rare final boss death bug" fix
[/list]

What's on the horizon, though? Well how about...

[list]
[*]Linux support!
[*]Steam Deck support!
[*]Better controller support for PS4, Switch Pro
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/fe360ac929e9a16e1548eb1590ed1658a3371605.jpg[/img]

But what if...

[list]
[*]Additional levels?
[*]More/Advanced character trials?
[*]Steam leaderboard integration?
[*]Christmas update?
[*]Other holiday updates?
[*]Making the bowling alley easier to access?
[/list]

Hopefully this excites you. See you next update!

-Manny

notes.title: Sole Iron Tail Pre-Release Newsletter!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/38eef51ac9a55fba8a3ab6bd0e330565ed758148.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/94b286ab7eb783e058dc61ff2c797286a75c6808.png[/img]

[b]Releasing November 9th![/b]
With the release of [url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=PVMK9AVTYt4]the most recent trailer[/url] last month, Sole Iron Tail's release has been announced for November 9th! Please spread this news where you can!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/f88e6a85541cf05195df0a56e6b9237139140e6c.png[/img]

[b]Tonsa Tweaks[/b]
Each level has received a ton of tweaks, fixes, and "glow ups" (am I cool yet?) thanks to the many awesome playtesters testing the game in the past month. These levels will definitely feel more polished, free-flowing, and slipp-ier/slide-ier!


[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/a698f37923ed372b84e6ea2e84d1161c3689635f.png[/img]

[b]Beyond the story...[/b]
With so many levels, scarves, bosses, and badges, the average completionist will have tons to do! For you guys, I have a little treat past 100%




[b]Thank You![/b]
For everyone who’s been sticking with this project since early 2019 to newcomers just reading this newsletter, I want to give a big super duper thanks for looking at my little project. Throughout the project i’ve had moments, some fun, many fantastic, though still with a few challenges along the way. Regardless, working on this game has been a treat, and I am super proud of what it has become (and what you will get to try out soon!). So to all mailing listers, wishlisters, playtesters, mentors, past co-developers (Ellen for art and +TEK/H-Mister for music), and other cool people, thank you!

-Manny Mallea

Have a happy Halloween and enjoy the game!

notes.title: Slippery Slopes in the Sole Iron Tail Steam Festival Demo!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/daecee5c33e0bf6710f5830f9dc083df6e50def7.gif[/img]

[b]Synopsis[/b]
Sole Iron Tail is a fast-paced platformer based around sliding, surfing, propelling, and charging using the main characters "Iron Tail". The game has been in development for nearly 2 years, appearing in events such as BostonFIG, PAX East, and the MassDiGI Game Challenge ([url=https://www.massdigi.org/sip-blog/2019-massdigi-game-challenge-winners-2-23-19/]of which it won Indie Runner Up![/url]).

[previewyoutube=-FWeQgltxZA;rightthumb][/previewyoutube]

[b]Demo Features[/b]
The Festival Demo features the tutorial and first stage of the game, which includes 3 levels full of snowy slopes, spooky caverns, and a giant, deadly boss! I hope you all enjoy getting a peak at the gameplay for Sole Iron Tail!



[b]About the Developer[/b]
"HOW DID PEOPLE MAKE THESE BEEPS AND BOOPS WORK!." I said to myself as a little kid, playing Mega Dude or Super Maria or whatever. One college degree later, I found out. Hello fellow game folk! My name is Manny Mallea, and i've been working on this beep-boopy game since becoming a college grad. I aim to give you (mostly) happy emotions with my games, while teaching myself how to make even better ones. I would love for you to try out this game and share your thoughts. Thanks for reading!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36913744/f4ce20c73f7787dd27985a055f7aa1da2529a857.png[/img]
